visualCharacteristics.purpose: Vertical list of article teasers: image, linked title, optional date and excerpt
visualCharacteristics.description: Stacked teasers in a white panel. Image (~260x150) left, text right from 600px (stacked on mobile): bold blue linked title, small grey date line, grey excerpt.

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per teaser: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = linked title (paragraph link or heading), optional date paragraph, excerpt paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for news, recipe or story lists where each item is image + title + excerpt in a single column. Keep the list heading and "View all" link as default content above the block. For a multi-column image-top grid use cards-article; for compact sidebar lists use cards-thumb-list.
